meta.title: A Procol user of ANOTHER company is treated as outside
gaps: Log in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval request email
Click Consult and verify the new email subject starts with Action:Consult
Enter a comment and an email address belonging to a Procol user from another company
Send the unchanged-subject email and wait for Procol to process the mailbox
Verify that the other company's user receives nothing
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Log in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval request email; Click Consult and verify the new email subject starts with Action:Consult; Enter a comment and an email address belonging to a Procol user from another company; Send the unchanged-subject email and wait for Procol to process the mailbox; Verify that the other company's user receives nothing
